items.title: Is Teradyne (TER) Changing The Robotics Story With Its New Physical AI Push?
items.summary: Teradyne (NasdaqGS:TER) unit Teradyne Robotics has partnered with German AI firm Sereact to deploy physical AI systems for retail and logistics operations. The collaboration features Sereact's vision language action platform for automated returns handling and piece picking in fulfillment centers. Real world deployments are already running at major European logistics hubs serving Zalando, with a joint demo shown at a recent industry event. The Teradyne Robotics and Sereact tie up on AI...
